text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I catch
a glimpse
of Мэдзиро Райан deep in
thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I wonder if anyone would come
with me...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I was gonna go to the aquarium this
weekend, but
my friend can't make it
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The tickets I got are about to expire
too, so I'm
trying to figure out what to
do.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait a sec. Are you free this
weekend?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Do you wanna go to the aquarium with
me?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Wooow... It's such a magical place!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
All those colorful fish—it's like an
underwater
field of flowers!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and did you know? Aquariums are
the new
hot spot to go.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because every aquarium has their
own
unique thing.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
One might have a huge variety of
jellyfish, and
another one might let you
touch the dolphins.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: It looks like this aquarium has a lot of strange and rare animals.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
See, it's even written on the signs. "A
Collection
of Mysterious Creatures!
Wildly Exciting!"
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they've got! Let's go and
see!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
There's beautiful fish, weird-looking
fish... The
variety here really is amazing!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: What else do they got... Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Oh?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Did you find a strange one?

text_block_list.text:
N-no, it's not that. But when I look
around...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
D-doesn't it seem like there are only...
c-couples
in here?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
True to her word, there are many young
couples
around us enjoying the
aquarium.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I guess aquariums really are hot spots.

text_block_list.text:
Aw, geez. I didn't even think about that,
but I
guess it makes sense.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, those two are really getting
close...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I gotta stop starin'! I came here to look
at the fish!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...Wow. That couple's walking with their
arms
around each other.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Let's focus on what's happening in the water.

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! Nothing hits the spot better
than a nice
sports drink!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp... Ahhh!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Phew... That settled me down. Seeing all
those
couples caught me off guard.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Are you tired from walking? Let's take a
break.
text_block_list.name: One Half of a Couple

text_block_list.text: Okay... Mind if I lean against you?
text_block_list.name: Other Half of a Couple

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! I'm all good now, so let's get
outta
here!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I don't know why, but I'm feeling
pretty
beat.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Is this what the "wildly exciting" part of
that sign
was about?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I'll focus my attention on the
water and
see what's up inside the tank...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Yikes!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's n-nothing! Nothing at all!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Our eyes just met in the reflection of the
glass...
and it was like...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: It was just like that one scene in volume six of Marine Lover!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Their eyes meet in the reflection... and
that's
when they first realize how the
other feels.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. I'm getting all distracted. I
should focus
on the fish!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ryan glances back into the tank.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What in the—I keep locking eyes with
you!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Is this what that sign meant by "wildly
exciting"?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I enjoy my time at the aquarium with
Мэдзиро Райан,
who has no trouble getting
excited all on her own.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I don't think that was what they meant,
but
nevertheless, I enjoy my time at the
aquarium
with Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
